conviction_note: The findings add up to a slightly positive +1.4. That comes from a low revenue bar (consensus about $3.7M, 28% below Q2's $5.14M), a pending fidelity/roadmap milestone, and a crowded and growing short (71.0M shares, 4.55 days to cover) with upside-paid skew. Against that, the stock rallied about 24% in two sessions into the print on IonQ sympathy, with no news of its own, and D-Wave's bookings miss sold off today. I put abs_move at 9.0 (above the 7.74 implied, because the core says hunters' sizes run small and realised vol is 115%) and p_up at 53, a weak lean. So the scaled number (+0.54) is far below the findings' sum: the sign is close to balanced, while the move size is large.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus is about $3.68-3.92M and the EPS consensus a loss of $0.05-0.06. Sources: TIKR 2026-11-08 ($3.68M, -$0.06; https://www.tikr.com/blog/rigetti-gained-19-friday-its-100-million-chips-award-hasnt-reached-revenue-yet), Motley Fool via Webull 2026-11-03 citing Yahoo ($3.7M; https://www.webull.com/news/15859599369018368), and Earnings Whispers ($3.92M, -$0.05; https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/x/RGTI). Two sources agree near $3.7M, and that is a sequential drop from Q2's $5.14M. The company gives no numeric revenue guidance. It said the $8.4M C-DAC order is recognised in Q4 2026.
positioning_check: Short interest was 71,041,710 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, up 5.37M. That is 21.3% of shares outstanding (333.8M on the 10-Q cover) and 4.55 days to cover. It has risen at four consecutive settlements, from 58.9M on 08-31 to 62.4M, 65.7M and 71.0M (https://equibles.com/stocks/rgti/short-interest). Schaeffer's put it at 18% of float on 2026-09-08. Baseline 25-delta skew is -7.27 vol points (upside paid), put/call OI 0.66, ATM IV 137.9%, event-implied move 7.74%. The short is crowded and building, and the option market is leaning up. Any negative here is shrunk for squeeze risk.

findings.finding: The revenue bar is low and system deliveries could clear it. Consensus Q3 revenue is about $3.7M (TIKR $3.68M, Yahoo $3.7M, Earnings Whispers $3.92M), a 28% sequential drop from Q2's $5.14M. On the 2026-08-06 call, management said three systems were targeted for delivery in 2026, Novera systems plus the 108-qubit C-DAC unit, and that it sees additional Novera demand. One Novera (about $2.85M at the $5.7M two-system order price) recognised in Q3 would put revenue at or above Q2. The C-DAC $8.4M is explicitly Q4, so a Q3 beat has to come from Novera or government work.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue has not reliably driven the reaction. Q2 2026, with revenue up 185% y/y and a sequential gain, bought +8.53% (2026-08-06). Q1 2026 (2026-05-11) fell 7.02% despite GAAP net income. In Q3 2025 a revenue miss coincided with -5.08%. The name trades on roadmap and sector more than on the revenue line.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus models a sequential revenue decline. If the market expected a Novera delivery in Q3, the bar would sit at or above $5M rather than $3.7M. Whether a system was recognised in Q3 is not public, since Rigetti announced no delivery after the Q2 call.
findings.independence: Consensus comes from TIKR (https://www.tikr.com/blog/rigetti-gained-19-friday-its-100-million-chips-award-hasnt-reached-revenue-yet) and Yahoo via Motley Fool (https://www.webull.com/news/15859599369018368). The $5.7M two-Novera order (https://thequantuminsider.com/2025/09/30/rigetti-announces-purchase-orders-for-two-quantum-computing-systems-totaling-approximately-5-7-million/) sets the unit price. Inference only: no document confirms a Q3 delivery.

findings.finding: A technology milestone is due and could land in this release, in either direction. As of 2026-08-06, Rigetti targeted about 99.5% median two-qubit fidelity on Cepheus-1-108Q 'later this year' (it was at about 99.1%) and promised a roadmap update 'later in 2026'. The 2026-08-20 restructuring release repeats the 99.5% target. The target has already slipped once: the 2026-01-09 update delayed general availability with the 108Q at 99.0%. Hitting it would be the first 108-qubit 99.5% claim. Missing it again would be a third deferral.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 2025 release (2025-08-12) carried 99.5% on the 36-qubit system and the stock rose 6.42%. After the 2026-01-09 108Q delay, analysts cut targets and the stock drew down through Q1 2026. The Q4 2025 report (2026-03-04) fell 4.45%.
findings.why_not_priced: No fidelity update has been published since August; no Rigetti releases came out in October beyond the earnings-date notice (https://fool.com/investing/2026/11/04/why-rigetti-computing-slipped-234-last-month). The stock is 63% off its high, which prices doubt rather than delivery. If the milestone were expected, the stock would not be trading at its October lows absent its sector bounce.
findings.independence: The Q2 call transcript repeats the target and the roadmap-update timing (https://www.webull.com/news/15398259088778240). The January slip is at https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/rigetti-computing-provides-update-108-qubit-system-2026-01-09. All are company documents, so this is one source family.

findings.finding: A large non-cash warrant gain in Q3 likely makes headline GAAP EPS beat the -$0.05/-0.06 consensus. The derivative warrant liability was $78.4M at 2026-06-30 (public warrants struck at $11.50) with the stock at $19.32. The stock closed Q3 at $15.74, down 18.5%, which implies a fair-value gain probably in the tens of millions, against a Q2 operating loss of $28.1M. Q2's GAAP loss included a $29.6M warrant charge in the opposite direction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 printed GAAP net income of $33.1M on warrant gains, and the stock fell 7.02% (2026-05-11). The market looks through this line.
findings.why_not_priced: Headline-scraping algorithms compare reported GAAP EPS with consensus. The gain is mechanical and not in most previews. It has no path to guidance or the multiple, so it is sized near zero.
findings.independence: The Q2 warrant charge and Q1 net income are confirmed by Quantum Computing Report (https://quantumcomputingreport.com/rigetti-computing-reports-q2-2026-financial-results-revenue-up-185-yoy-100m-chips-act-loi-and-hpe-supercomputing-partnership/). The price path is from Yahoo daily bars (Jun 30 $19.32, Sep 30 $15.74).

findings.finding: The short is crowded, still growing, and the option market leans up. Short interest has risen at four straight settlements to 71.0M shares (21.3% of shares outstanding, 4.55 days to cover) at 2026-10-15. Skew is -7.27 vol points, so calls are richer than puts. The stock gained 19.3% on 2026-11-06 and 10.5% on 2026-11-09 on peer news alone, which shows how this float reacts to good news.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-11-06/09 moves (+19.3%, +10.5%) on IonQ's print and the 2025 squeezes on contract news show outsized upside reactions when news is good. Down reactions on prints (-7.0%, -14.6%) show the short also gets paid on disappointments.
findings.why_not_priced: The skew already leans up, so part of this is priced. What is not in the skew is that the short kept building through October (+5.4M shares in the last settlement), so the squeeze fuel is larger than at any earlier print this year.
findings.independence: Schaeffer's 18% of float on 2026-09-08 (https://www.schaeffersresearch.com/content/news/2026/09/08/rigetti-stock-rallies-on-100-million-funding-deal). The skew is from the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: The stock ran up on peer news, not its own, and today's peer print was weak. RGTI rose from $9.85 (11-05) to $12.98 (11-09), up 32% in two sessions with no news of its own, after IonQ's Q3 (revenue $173.8M vs $141M, FY26 guide raised to $505-515M). D-Wave reported before the open today (2026-11-10): revenue of $4.5M beat, but bookings fell 19% to $1.9M and the stock fell 6-8% premarket. RGTI trades at $12.19-12.27 intraday, down about 6%. Rigetti has nothing like IonQ's scale, and the sympathy bid is at risk of a give-back if its own bookings look like D-Wave's.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The October sector de-rating (RGTI -23.4% in October on IonQ's dilutive deal and sector selling) shows the stock trades on peers. Prints into sympathy rallies have been sold: 2025-05-12 -14.59%, 2026-05-11 -7.02%.
findings.why_not_priced: Part of the D-Wave read-through is already in today's roughly -6%. Not priced: Rigetti has given no bookings metric since August. If its pipeline looks like D-Wave's, the +32% two-day sympathy move has no company support. Sized small because it is a peer proxy and because it runs against the skew and the crowded short.
findings.independence: IonQ results: https://investors.ionq.com/news/news-details/2026/IonQ-Announces-Record-3Q26-Revenues-and-Raises-FY2026-Guidance-to-505---515-Million-as-Backlog-Grows-to-1-2-Billion/. RGTI's +19.3% on 11-06 with no news of its own: https://www.tikr.com/blog/rigetti-gained-19-friday-its-100-million-chips-award-hasnt-reached-revenue-yet. D-Wave 8-K: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001907982/000190798226000180/qbts-20261110xexx991.htm.

findings.finding: The CHIPS award should show its first $43.9M tranche in the Q3 balance sheet. Under the 2026-09-08 8-K, Rigetti issued 7,739,938 shares to Commerce at an implied $12.92 ($100M). Cash comes in three tranches: $43.9M 'on or as soon as practicable after' 2026-09-04, then $29.9M and $26.2M on milestones. The money funds readout electronics, a new cryostat and fab work. If received in Q3, it roughly offsets a quarter's operating burn (about $30M), so cash would be flat to up from $541.3M. D-Wave's identical deal shows a $100M 'uncollected equity issuance proceeds' contra-equity line and no cash receipt at 9/30, so timing is uncertain.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The definitive agreement itself lifted the stock about 6% on 2026-09-08. Prior ATM raises in H1 2025 ($346.7M) did not prevent the -14.59% reaction on 2025-05-12.
findings.why_not_priced: Bears cite dilution and cash burn as the October driver (https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/semiconductors/nasdaq-rgti/rigetti-computing/news/rigetti-computing-rgti-is-down-66-after-quantum-pullback-hig). A cash balance that did not fall would contradict that narrative, and previews do not model the tranche. On the lesson-4 question of what the money buys: it funds the stated roadmap (cryostat, readout, fab), with 2.3% dilution at $12.92, about today's price. Signed small positive.
findings.independence: D-Wave's Q3 balance sheet (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001907982/000190798226000180/qbts-20261110xexx991.htm) shows the same-terms award uncollected at 9/30, which cuts against Q3 receipt. That is why the finding is small.

findings.finding: Insiders sold in September. Per TIKR, CEO Subodh Kulkarni sold 120,000 shares (about $1.88M) and CFO Jeffrey Bertelsen sold about $375k. EDGAR shows Form 144s on 2026-08-20 (three), 09-03 and 09-09, with Form 4s on 09-04 and 09-10. No insider buying, and no 8-K or Form 4 since 2026-09-10.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction to insider filings on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced: the filings are two months old and appear to be routine 10b5-1-style sales. Filed for completeness.
findings.independence: TIKR (https://www.tikr.com/blog/rigetti-gained-19-friday-its-100-million-chips-award-hasnt-reached-revenue-yet) gives the amounts. EDGAR is the same fact, so this is one finding.

findings.finding: There has been no DARPA QBI Stage B news three months after management said it was 'optimistic about advancing to DARPA Phase B relatively soon' (2026-08-06 call). Rigetti was left out of the 11-team Stage B cohort in November 2025. DARPA said more teams may join on staggered timelines, and Stage B runs about a year, so the window for a late entry is closing. An update or another deferral is likely to come up on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025-11-10 print (-5.08%) came days after the Stage B list excluding Rigetti (2025-11-06).
findings.why_not_priced: Previews focus on revenue and Novera and do not mention QBI. A Stage B entry announced with results would be a large positive surprise, while a non-answer is mostly priced. The absence of news is weak evidence, so this is sized small with a wide, positively skewed range.
findings.independence: Stage B list: https://quantumcomputingreport.com/darpas-quantum-benchmarking-initiative-qbi-advances-with-eleven-teams-moving-to-stage-b/. No later Rigetti QBI announcement was found.

outside_window.finding: The $8.4M C-DAC 108-qubit order is recognised as revenue in Q4 2026, after installation and acceptance testing. The Q3 call may confirm or slip that timing, but the revenue itself shows in the Q4 report.
The second and third CHIPS tranches ($29.9M and $26.2M) depend on Commerce milestone determinations with no dates given.

baseline_tension: The upside-paid skew (-7.27) and the growing short (4.55 days to cover) agree with the small positive lean. The +9.9% 5-day run-up, made entirely on peer news, cuts against it, and so does the name's record of falling on 4 of 7 prints. p_up is held near 50 for that reason.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): revenue finding cut from +0.8 to +0.6, because this name's reactions do not track the revenue line.
Lesson 2 (one-offs): warrant-gain finding cut from +0.2 to +0.1. Q1 2026 GAAP net income from the same mechanism was followed by -7.0%.
Lesson 7 (positioning) and lesson 5 (proxies): peer read-through negative cut from -1.0 to -0.6. It runs against the upside skew and a crowded, building short, and it is a peer proxy.
Lesson 5 (absence is not evidence): DARPA no-news finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2. Insider-sale finding cut from -0.2 to -0.1 as two-month-old public filings.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the CHIPS finding was already signed after asking what the money buys (roadmap R&D). Left at +0.3.
Scaled measurement: p_up moved from 52 to 53 after the negatives shrank. abs_move left at 9.0.
